certification.text: I, the undersigned, do hereby certify that I am the ______ of the person named above, and that he/she has completed the required number of hours of behind-the-wheel driving experience with a restricted license, instruction permit, or restricted permit issued pursuant to NRS 483.267. 483.270 or 483.280.

unfillable: Minutes Subtotal from Additional Sheets (this copy lists every drive)
notes: Page 1 is the certification (parent signs; notary or DMV Field Services representative signs); page 2 is the log with Column A (daytime) and Column B (nighttime), about 17 rows each, then the DLD-130A additional sheet.

Each drive goes on its own line. A drive with both day and night minutes is split: the day part in Column A and the night part in Column B, with begin/end times split at the day/night boundary (evening drives: day first; drives starting before noon: night first).
Times use AM/PM; the form rejects military time.

acceptance.basis: Only the DLD-130 or the RoadReady app log is accepted; signatures must be originals and photocopies are not acceptable.
